items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I worked with Woody Herman, you know, Maynard Ferguson, and Benny Goodman’s big bands.

ctx.x: There’s a rapport that takes place between a conductor and an orchestra.

Yeah. I think my work, I’ve enjoyed playing background and being in bands. I’ve played in big bands more than most jazz piano players. I worked with Woody Herman, you know, Maynard Ferguson, and Benny Goodman’s big bands. And I think being one of the boys in the band helped me understand musicians better. Because I know how I felt as a sideman so I mean these people in the orchestra, they’re sort of sidemen. I hate to use that expression but you know and I know you can be, psychologically I learned how to conduct…
